$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNT (AIP France, chart dated 2024-02-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Avignon - Pujaut

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
AD reserved for radio equipped ACFT.
Landing for outside users is prohibited except authorization given by the AD operator.
AD reserved for gliders, parachuting, operating ACFT and paramotor school.
RWY 16L/34R only reserved for gliding.
Simultaneous use of both RWY 16L/34R and 12/30 is prohibited.
Circling and going around prohibited for ACFT not mentioned earlines.
Reduced TODA RWY 16R, 12 and 30 due to presence of trees at the end of RWY.
Reduced TODA RWY 34L due to presence of farm track at the end of RWY.
OCT to JUL possible presence of sheep on AD.
Users must be aware that paratroopers and winched gliders may cross the RWY.
Presence of a 10m building (wind tunnel) close to THR 16L.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
PJE at AD (NR 402) every day from SR to SS, FL 135, PJE actual activity provided by ORANGE APP and AVIGNON TWR.
Outside these SKED and above FL 135, PJE activity issued by NOTAM.
Area restricted to PJE west of RWYs.
Glider winching activity on AD (NR 986), SFC-2350 AMSL, SR - SS non marked cable.
Ground lighting (revolving light).
Activity announced on PUJAUT A/A.
AEM (NR 9557): 650 ft ASFC, HJ.
Activity: paramotor school only.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Atterrissage pour les usagers extérieurs interdit sauf autorisation donnée par l'exploitant d'AD.
AD réservé au vol à voile, au parachutisme, aux avions de servitude et à l'école de paramoteur.
Piste 16L/34R exclusivement réservée à l'activité vélivole.
Utilisation simultanée des pistes 16L/34R et 12/30 interdite.
Tour de piste et remise des gaz interdits aux ACFT non précédemment cités.
TODA pistes 16R, 12 et 30 réduites cause présence d'arbres en bout de piste.
TODA piste 34L réduite en raison d'un chemin agricole en bout de piste.
OCT à JUL - Présence de moutons possible sur l'AD.
L'attention des usagers est attirée sur la possible traversée des RWY par des parachutistes et des planeurs en attelage.
Présence d'un bâtiment (soufflerie) d'une hauteur de 10m à proximité du seuil de piste 16L.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Parachutage sur AD (N° 402) tous les jours SR-SS, FL 135, activité réelle connue de ORANGE APP et AVIGNON TWR.
Autres HOR et au-dessus du FL 135, activité annoncée par NOTAM.
A l'ouest des pistes zone réservée au parachutisme.
Treuillage sur AD (N°986), SFC-2350 AMSL, SR - SS câble non balisé.
Balisage lumineux au sol (feu tournant).
Activité annoncée sur PUJAUT A/A.
AEM (N° 9557) : 650 ft ASFC, HJ.
Activité "École de Paramoteur" exclusivement.
